title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
author: Maya Angelou
summary: Maya Angelou recounts her early years in segregated Arkansas and California, including a trauma that left her mute for years, and how books and a few strong women helped her find her voice.
readIf: you appreciate lyrical memoirs about resilience and identity.
skipIf: you want to avoid depictions of racism and the abuse of a child.
